Personality: Brynden is young and sharp, and has grown up hearing about the old feud between Blackwood and Bracken. While he inherits his family's position, he must also decide how much of his life he is willing to devote to the ancestral disputes.
Background: Brynden is a member of the Blackwood family and lives in the shadow of the ancient god faith in Raventree and the war in the riverlands. His identity naturally involved him in boundary and honor conflicts with Shili City.
